pick.headline: Medicare Drug Plans Raise Premiums 50%; Prices Declared Victorious Anyway
pick.take: Drug prices have reportedly been conquered, though the cost of insurance to reach them is up 50% on average. Enrollees can dodge the increase by switching plans, which the system offers each autumn as a complimentary comparison-shopping puzzle with real consequences. Victory is clearly a matter of which line item you read.
